text: The SRP features a dual-hazard design focusing on both flood and drought risks, a unique approach for provincial projects. It includes a Contingent Emergency Response Component that allowed rapid fund reallocation to address the COVID-19 emergency. The project also emphasizes strong environmental and social safeguards and utilizes digital tools for data-driven irrigation operations. Additional Financing proposed by the World Bank in 2020 expanded the project's scope to include public health emergencies.
